name: JADI
recent: Jadi Imaging 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日召开特别股东大会，股东通过削减 RM40.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。公司近期也因行使凭单 B 而分两次发行新股，分别于 9 月 10 日及 15 日上市。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比与同比均大幅下滑。
notable: 特别股东大会通过削减 RM40.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。
因行使凭单 B 发行新股，分别于 2026 年 9 月 10 日及 15 日上市。
2026 年 9 月 22 日举行第 25 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
risks: 股本削减计划仍需满足相关条件方可完成。
最新季度营收环比下降 49.5%，同比下降 80.0%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM269,000，环比下降 49.5%，同比下降 80.0%；净利为 RM298,000，净利率 110.8%，上一季度净利率为 -179.4%。

recent_en: Jadi Imaging held an EGM on 16 Nov 2026 where shareholders approved a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by RM40.00 million. The company also listed new shares from the exercise of Warrants B on 10 and 15 Sep 2026. Latest quarterly revenue (period ended 30 Jun 2026) declined sharply both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: EGM passed a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by RM40.00 million.
New shares from the exercise of Warrants B were listed on 10 and 15 Sep 2026.
The 25th AGM was held on 22 Sep 2026 and all resolutions were passed.
risks_en: The capital reduction remains subject to fulfilment of conditions.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 49.5% QoQ and 80.0% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM269,000, down 49.5% QoQ and 80.0% YoY; net income was RM298,000 with a net margin of 110.8%, compared with a net margin of -179.4% in the prior quarter.
